exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric care (EmOC) signal functions
JSY programme facilities vs. non-programme (private) facilities
outcome: Functionality of facilities providing emergency obstetric care
Proportion of childbirths at facilities meeting standards for basic EmOC
Provision of specific EmOC signal functions
cohort: Women giving birth in Madhya Pradesh, India
finding: Despite a high proportion of births occurring in public facilities under the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) programme, two-thirds of these facilities did not meet standards for basic EmOC provision, highlighting the need for significant improvements in EmOC availability and functionality within the programme.
